title: Qualcomm’s Next Flagship Snapdragon SoC To Target Higher Frequencies Of 5.40GHz While Sticking With TSMC’s 2nm N2P Node, But IPC Gains Are Rumored To Stay Under 10%

For next year’s SoC, the San Diego firm isn’t expected to stay on TSMC’s 2nm “N2P” process, while targeting higher clock speeds, but we shouldn’t get excited for a massive performance jump. title: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan Is Impressed By Photonic Quantum Computing – Says He Now Leans on AI Agents to Do His “Homework”
content: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan believes that for quantum computing to be viable, companies have to address market areas with actual demand. The executive discussed quantum computing and how he uses artificial intelligence, among other topics, in the QuantumJane podcast, where he revealed that he had actually invested in quantum computing companies with his own funds instead of the funds of a venture capital firm that he ran.
